steps.hint: “Hi {name}, this is Arvind from The Sleep Company. Is now a good time?”
steps.tip: Open with your name, the brand and permission to talk, all in the first 10 seconds.

steps.hint: “What matters most to you: firmness, cooling or price?”
steps.tip: Ask one open question before you pitch anything.

steps.hint: “Given that, the {product} is the right fit because…”
steps.tip: Tie the product to what they told you, not to its spec sheet.

steps.hint: “There's a no-cost EMI plan, so it's a small amount each month.”
steps.tip: Bring up EMI before price turns into the objection.

steps.hint: “You also get the 100-night trial and the warranty, so there's no risk.”
steps.tip: Mention the trial and warranty before they decide. It takes the risk away.

steps.hint: “Shall I send the quote now and call you Thursday at 6?”
steps.tip: Always end with a dated next step.

scenarios.title: Hot lead · delivery question
scenarios.brief: Visited the RT Nagar store and tried the Smart Luxe. Wants to know about delivery.
lines: Hi, yes. I visited your RT Nagar store last week.
I liked the Smart Luxe. How soon can you deliver it?
Okay. What does it come to with the protector?
That's a bit more than I planned for.
And if I don't like it after a few weeks?

scenarios.title: Price objection · SLA missed
scenarios.brief: Asked to hold the price two days ago and went quiet. The SLA is already missed.
lines: Oh. I was expecting a call two days ago.
Honestly, I found a cheaper cooling mattress online.
Is the hybrid really better for me? I sleep hot.
Can you still hold the old price?
Maybe I should come and try it first.
Okay, when could I come in?

scenarios.title: EMI close · decision day
scenarios.brief: Tried the Tranquo chair in-store. Wants the 6-month no-cost EMI and said he'd decide today.
lines: Hi. I said I'd decide today, right?
I want the 6-month no-cost EMI. Is that still on?
What paperwork do you need from me?
And the warranty, how long is it?
Does the seat cushion come with it?
